artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a historical or religious setting. There is a seated woman with a child on her lap, viewed fully. The woman is facing slightly to the side, with long hair under a veil, dressed in robes. The child is slightly tilted towards a kneeling figure. The kneeling figure is shown from the waist up, bowing towards the child, with shoulder-length hair and a robe. Three standing men are also visible, each with distinct facial features, wearing elaborate robes and headwear. Two men hold ornate objects and appear to have long hair. Another man stands holding a vessel, dressed in a fitted outfit. A crown is on the ground around the central figures. The background includes architectural features, additional figures, and animals in a rural setting.

artworks.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image features several figures, including three seated individuals and multiple angels. The central seated figure is a man with long, curly hair and a beard, wearing a crown and elaborate robes. Flanking him are two individuals in similar attire holding spherical objects topped with crosses. The central figure appears to be crowning a seated woman in front of him, who has long, wavy hair and wears a flowing gown. Surrounding them are small angels with wings, some in prayerful poses. The background shows detailed drapery and more angels above. The scene is depicted in monochrome, emphasizing the clothing folds and creating a sense of reverence.

artworks.title: Joachim's Sacrifice
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with multiple figures and architectural elements. The drawing features several figures in elaborate robes and headgear inside a detailed interior space. In the foreground, two dogs play. Behind the figures, there is a depiction of a biblical scene with a shepherd, an angel, and sheep. The background architecture includes columns and decorative elements, with the inclusion of a table with coins and a book. The composition is created in a detailed monochrome line style.

artworks.title: The Presentation of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with human figures. The image shows a detailed architectural structure and lavishly dressed figures throughout. There are ornate staircases, intricate clothing patterns, individuals in various postures, flowing garments, and complex headwear. The setting seems to be a grand interior, potentially from a historical period. The precise line work indicates the use of fine line hatching to depict depth and texture for a rich visual narrative.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing against a textured background. She is wearing a crown, long hair, and an ornate garment. She holds a sword in her right hand and drapes the robe over her left arm. At her feet are a broken wheel and a small bell.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two figures partially submerged in water. A wooden mill with turning wheels stands on the riverbank, leading to a castle-like structure on a rocky outcrop in the distance. Trees surround the landscape, creating a natural boundary at the horizon line. The detailed linework creates shading and texture, giving the illustration an antique feel. The color scheme is predominantly sepia, highlighting the contrasts and details within the composition.

artworks.title: The Flight of Saint Elizabeth with the  Infant Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a serene outdoor scene involving celestial figures. The drawing depicts a reclining figure at the forefront, surrounded by angelic beings with wings. One of these winged figures appears to be supporting the reclined figure, while another interacts with a small child seated nearby. Above this main group, additional winged figures are visible in the sky. The landscape includes trees that frame the central figures, and soft, hilly forms in the background provide a sense of depth and setting for the scene. Elegant drapery and a gentle expression emphasize the peaceful and nurturing nature of the interaction. The script below the image suggests a narrative or contextual explanation for the scene.

artworks.title: The Penitence of Mary Magdalen
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling in profile view on the right side. The person has long flowing hair, hands clasped together in front of their chest, and is looking upwards. They are wearing a robe and surrounded by a forest setting with a tree and rustic hut to the left. Several angels are also present, with one on the hut's roof. The background includes trees and clouds. The text "MARIA MAGDALENA" is inscribed below the oval frame, accompanied by Latin text below it.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene featuring a figure with a pig standing next to a tree, and a village in the background. The setting is detailed with trees creating a tranquil atmosphere. A small chapel is visible on the left side along with distant structures. The scene is framed in an oval shape, with delicate linework showcasing the texture of the foliage and elements in the drawing.

artworks.title: Saint Cecilia in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with curly hair, wearing draped classical attire and holding a musical instrument. Around them are trees, water with a distant town, a boat with a rowing person, a tower by the water, and a cityscape with spires. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame with ornate edges.

artworks.title: Saint Egidius and a Doe
artworks.description: The image is an illustration with a slightly elevated point of view looking into a natural scene that includes a figure and various landscape elements. The main focus is a large, textured tree. The illustration features fine, detailed linework and cross-hatching, using a monochrome sepia color palette. In the foreground, a monk-like figure is reading a book next to a cross with vines, and a stag is nearby. In the background, there is a church with a steeple among trees, brush, and foliage. The image is enclosed within an oval border with the word "EGIDVM" inscribed above.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: This is an image of a knight fighting a dragon. The knight is mounted on a horse, wearing armor and holding a lance, facing a dragon. The dragon has wings, claws, and a reptilian body, positioned in a combat stance on the ground. In the background, there are ruins of a castle on a hill, birds flying in the sky, trees, foliage, and a distant bridge over a river. It depicts a classic battle scene between a hero and a fearsome creature.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing next to a tree, wearing a tattered garment. He is barefoot and holding a staff in one hand and a scroll in the other. A lamb is lying beside him, and the background shows a landscape with trees, a river, and distant hills. The scene is enclosed in an oval frame with etched details.

artworks.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar
artworks.description: The image features a figure on horseback wearing elaborate clothing, positioned slightly right and towards the center. In the background, distant trees and faint structures hint at a horizon. The intricate brushstrokes create textures in the clothing and foliage with a monochrome color palette of black and white. The rider interacts with another figure by a tree, while more figures walk on a path through sparse trees with birds flying above.

artworks.title: Saint William the Hermit
artworks.description: This is an image of a bearded figure sitting in a cave-like setting. The figure is next to an opening in the rock, surrounded by dense branches or thatch. There is a jug on a ledge to the left. In the background, there is a scene with buildings resembling a village or monastery. The image is created using detailed lines and cross-hatching, with foliage framing the cave.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Hubert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man kneeling before a stag with a cross between its antlers, set in a woodland area. In the center, a stag stands with a cross between its antlers. A man in ornate attire kneels before the stag, a horse stands nearby, and two dogs are in the foreground. The background shows foliage, trees, and a distant rider chasing a deer.

artworks.title: Ruined Buildings near a River Bank
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient building with a tower, surrounded by overgrown vegetation. The background features a sky with stylized clouds. The technique appears to be an etching or pen-and-ink drawing, characterized by fine lines creating a textured surface. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily dark lines against cream-toned paper. In the distance, a small figure walks along a path leading to rolling hills under the sky.

artworks.title: Two Barns
artworks.description: The etching depicts a rural scene with two thatched cottages surrounded by hedges and sparse trees. The horizon is obscured by a line of trees blending with the sky. The artist uses fine, detailed line work to create texture and depth, particularly in the thatched roofs and foliage. The palette is monochrome, with variations in line density conveying light and shadow. The ground is detailed with grasses and pathways leading towards the cottages, while the sky is lightly sketched with wisps of clouds.

artworks.title: Monumental Entry
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view in a detailed ink drawing style. The horizon line is in the middle distance with clouds above it. Architectural ruins are depicted close to the viewer with hatching techniques. A lone tree is on the left side, reaching towards the sky filled with clouds. In the distance, a small figure is walking along a path. The drawing is monochrome with black ink on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Hovel at the Bridge
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a rural scene with a countryside dwelling amidst natural surroundings. The composition features a range of trees and a small building against the sky. Detailed lines define the landscape and architecture. A dirt path leads to the farmhouse, and a board fence guides the eye towards figures walking across a bridge. A tree is depicted on the right. The color palette is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Park with Terrace and a Balustrade with Statues
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a raised bridge where figures are walking. A small boat floats on the water in the foreground and a statue stands among trees on the right. The style appears to be a monochrome ink drawing with intricate details.

artworks.title: New York et Brooklyn - Vue prise au dessus dela batterie
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of New York and Brooklyn, with a harbor filled with ships of various sizes. The view is from above, looking down at the city and the water. The skyline is filled with buildings, and there are patches of greenery and parks visible. The buildings are detailed with brushstrokes, and the color palette consists of blues, browns, greens, and touches of peach in the sky.

artworks.title: Cosimo II de' Medici
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person showing the upper body, from the chest up. The individual is positioned in the center, facing left but gazing slightly towards the viewer. The person has a smooth, youthful face with softly defined features and short hair styled upward. They wear a high, elaborate ruffled collar and an intricately patterned garment. Surrounding this central portrait is ornate decorative line work resembling filigree patterns, interwoven with ribbons that contain text. The background is beige and filled with decorative elements, giving an ornate and classical feel to the composition.
